name: Shared MemoryRuntime Service
description: Define and implement the shared MemoryRuntime service as a scoped Effect service with bank lifecycle management. This service serves as the central coordination point for all memory operations across the system.
purpose: Establish the core MemoryRuntime service as a scoped Effect service that manages memory bank lifecycles, enabling all other memory features to build on a uniform foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: MemoryRuntime service is defined as a scoped Effect service in TypeScript
Bank lifecycle management includes create, open, close, archive, delete operations
Service is injectable via Effect context
All memory operations route through the MemoryRuntime service
rollback_strategy: Revert bank registry to last known consistent state
recovery_strategy: Replay bank lifecycle journal from checkpoint
